name: gameplay-promo
description: Film your game and cut it into a promo video: a staged opener on the main character, gameplay sampled from a take you play yourself, and a closing card — scored to a track from your own project.

plugins.name: gameplay-promo
plugins.description: Film a game and cut it into a promo video — a staged opener on the main character, gameplay sampled out of one long played take, a closing title card, and a music track chosen from the project, with the cuts landing on the beat. Captures real footage from the running game rather than recreating it, and needs only ffmpeg and Node.
